top_signals.title: Asian Chip Stocks Extend Losses on Funding Worry, DeepSeek Model
top_signals.summary: Asian semiconductor stocks tumbled again Monday, as DeepSeek’s latest model sparked concerns over demand for chips, compounding market fears over AI financing.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: India’s latest student protests pin Modi on revision of electoral rolls
top_signals.summary: A reversal by the Indian leader would hand a victory to his opponents and call into question recent election wins for his ruling party.
